answer: Anchor seats to payment rails (proposal): one deposit token per KYC-verified person, deduped on document hash; one seat per live token, refundable through that rail; each epoch's dawn revalidates it. Banks verify real persons under audited AML law, so fake papers are criminal and a farm needs N rented identities: mule rent is linear, recurring, and profitable only while a head's per-epoch share tops it. The rail is a river of evidence: whoever proves one wallet funds many seats — a raven after the bounty — claws back its deposits. Seams: cheap mules; split funding; bribed processors.
